title: Human-in-the-loop open-set leukocyte morphology analysis from full-smear images

research_scope.unknown_meaning: morphology outside the known training taxonomy

dataset.version: Scientific Reports 2022 dataset release; exact archive version to be recorded after download

split.patient_or_sample_grouping: use official patient/sample identifiers if provided; otherwise document unavailable identifiers and avoid inventing them

detector.rationale: minimal new dependency burden, official torchvision implementation already compatible with project dependencies, straightforward bounding-box inference, and no requirement to benchmark multiple detector families in Delivery 1
detector.initialization: COCO-pretrained backbone if weights are available in the execution environment; otherwise ImageNet-pretrained backbone documented before training
detector.input_size: short-side resize policy to be frozen from dataset loader smoke results; no test-set tuning
augmentation: horizontal flip only if compatible with annotation transforms
conservative color jitter only after smoke validation
detector.selection_metric: validation WBC candidate recall with mAP50 as secondary tie-breaker

morphology.primary_open_set_score: MSP unknown score = 1 - max softmax probability

calibration.threshold_source: known validation data only, plus predeclared development uncertainty set only if available before final evaluation
